newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lan Chile plans two new Frankfurt flights.
newsitem.headline: Lan Chile plans two new Frankfurt flights.

text.p: Lan Chile hopes to increase Germany flights by 50 percent to six a week next year, its Germany GSA Aerotrans Luftfahrtagentur GmbH, said.
Aerotrans sales manager Germany, Lothar Schaller, said the Chilean national carrier had applied for and received two additional slots at Frankfurt airport.
"We expect the flight frequency to be increased to six from June 1997," he told Reuters in an interview.
The airline currently flies Frankfurt-Madrid-Santiago four times a week with a Boeing 767-300 aircraft.
Schaller said air cargo demand for Santiago was very strong at present and looked set to continue.
"It is going sensationally well. In October, Lan Chile did not leave Frankfurt with a single empty (container) position, and the load factor speaks for itself," he said.

Aerotrans also offers capacity to Santiago on the new weekly Cargolux Boeing 747-200 freighter service under an agreement with Lan Chile, Schaller said. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
